craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-vīra of the cremation ground — Rauhine register throughout: broken-middle-drunk → gore teaches → brow burns → sky speaks → parted freed. Wearing-shown; parted-yet-freed seal; sati-api concessive per UNC. Rejected: (a) freed→free → killed: freed was bound. Read aloud: BRAH-ma-FULL su-PREME … BE-ing, THOUGH-part-ed, FREED.

lines: Brahma-full supreme — god, when wearing Bhairava-shape —
that shown — principle-knower — being, though parted, freed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: paramabrahmamayas tvaṃ deva yadāśrayasi bhairavākāram tat prathayasi tattvajñaḥ saty api bhede vimukta iti

reads_against.argmap: When freed despite difference? → Form-taken shown; differing-freed sealed.
c1_essence: Egg-middled saps drunk; shown within as-if.
Rosary held turns world within by letters.
Bubbles jar; brow-eye burning taught supreme-fire.
Aimed inward expanding shows unstained self all-states.
Sky-clad speaks bare; veil questioned covering.
Destroyer shown gleaming-bodied from dark ground.
